That is a lab-browser limit — not a Birkly failure. Birkly still injects the tools script, stamps toolname/tooldescription on allowlisted forms, and registers tools in browsers that do support WebMCP. Verify locally with the steps below. The separate llms.txt check needs /llms.txt on your site (served automatically from a published Agent Guide).

admin.ag_tools_verify_body: On a supported Chromium build (146+), enable the #enable-webmcp-testing flag and open a page with tools on. The registered tools appear in the browser’s model-context inspector.
